{{Top|leg}}
The '''Revitalization of the Whuffa''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Dathomir Magic|technique]] that could revitalize the body, or, with a sufficient will, allow the re-growth of a limb.

The technique's name comes from the regenerative powers of the [[Whuffa worm]].
